limitations: Only two digests were checked (one platform binary, one checksums manifest) out of 10 release assets; the other 8 platform archives were not individually queried, though GitHub attestations are normally generated per-build-workflow-run rather than per-asset, so a 404 on these two is a reasonable proxy, not exhaustive per-asset proof.

The release.yml read is source review of the current default branch, not the exact workflow revision that produced the v8.30.1 release (published 2026-03-21); the workflow file may have changed since that release ran.
This is a point-in-time recheck; it does not predict whether attestations will be added to a future release.
